story_facts.headline: Hackers take over Kenya's president's website, demand 5 Bitcoins ransom
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Kenya's president hacked website was defaced with demeaning messages targeting the president; the unknown group responsible for the attack are demanding a ransom of 5 Bitcoins (approximately $317,215).
